literal_meaning: ঘটের মধ্যে বুদ্ধি নেই (pot's inside no intelligence)
figurative_meaning_en: Similar to an empty pot (lacking intelligence or sense)
similar_in_english: Not the sharpest tool in the shed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘটে বুদ্ধি নেই, কখনো কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারে না।
এই কাজে তার ঘটে বুদ্ধি নেই, সবসময় ভুল করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no brains in his pot; he can never make a decision.
She is empty-headed like a pot; she always messes up the task.
history: Originated from traditional Bengali rural life where empty earthen pots symbolize emptiness or lack of substance, used proverbially to denote stupidity.
note: Refers to traditional earthen pots (ঘট) common in Bengali households.
